scope.build_configuration: Release (App Sandbox enabled, ad-hoc signed; Sparkle + LLC audited separately)
scope.workload_distinction: Standard accelerated workday suite (~4-5 min) is distinct from the detached long-running 8h soak + 24h Voice-On idle harness; full 8h/24h data is reported separately once completed.
not_measured: Full-SoC wall power / battery-life hours (sudo powermetrics unavailable without elevated privileges; Xcode Power Profiler does not support macOS)
Other Apple silicon SKUs (8 GB M1/M2/M4), Intel Macs, or macOS 14/15 idle behavior
Continuous network-sync or multi-week hibernation without process restart

storage_distinction.note: Standard local Release Rasc.app (~40.5 MiB) does not embed Sparkle or the 622 MiB speech model; GitHub Release builds embed Sparkle + cdhash-pinned Library Load Constraints (~44.4 MiB), and the speech model remains an opt-in one-time download.
